headline: Highest risk is medium data leakage: Perplexity’s vendor-hosted browsing can expose uploaded documents, while Whisper only handles audio files and has no network egress.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Perplexity can browse live web content and render citations, so malicious content could be surfaced to a downstream consumer. Whisper is only a speech model with audio-file input and no interactive tool chain, so there is no direct bidirectional channel. The pairwise bridge is therefore weak and mostly manual or indirect.
conditions: IF Perplexity outputs web-derived text that a human copies into Whisper-related prompts or transcripts
IF an external orchestrator feeds Perplexity output into a downstream parser
mitigations: Keep a human review step before reusing Perplexity text
Strip instructions from any copied transcript before transcription
Use separate workspaces for search notes and audio jobs
Disable any automation that forwards Perplexity output into another agent

B_data_leakage.rationale: Perplexity touches uploaded documents and browsing context in a vendor-hosted backend, so sensitive content can leave the local environment. Whisper only processes audio files and has no network egress, which limits the second agent’s leakage path. The pair still creates a medium risk because one side can ingest sensitive files by default, even though the other side is comparatively contained.
conditions: IF uploaded documents contain secrets, regulated data, or confidential material
IF Perplexity is used on the same dataset as Whisper-transcribed audio
mitigations: Avoid uploading sensitive documents to Perplexity
Redact audio transcripts before any cross-agent use
Use a local-only transcription path for sensitive audio
Separate regulated and non-regulated workloads into different projects

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Neither agent can write the filesystem, modify git state, or spawn subprocesses, so there is no shared mutable write surface to contend over. Perplexity is vendor-hosted and Whisper has no network egress, but those differences do not create a write conflict. The pairwise overlap is read/analysis only.
conditions: IF either agent gains filesystem write or git mutation capability through an external wrapper
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only
Do not wrap either agent in a shared write-enabled orchestrator
Review any future connector that adds file mutation
Use separate output directories if automation is added

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity can produce search-derived answers and citations, but Whisper is not an action-taking agent and has no tool surface to automatically execute those outputs. Without a downstream automation layer, Whisper cannot treat Perplexity’s text as authoritative in a harmful way. The cascade is therefore limited to manual misuse rather than an autonomous failure chain.
conditions: IF a human or wrapper script forwards Perplexity output into a workflow that acts on it without verification
IF Whisper output is used as if it were factual rather than transcription
mitigations: Add a verification step before any action on Perplexity output
Label Whisper output as transcription, not truth
Block automation that converts either output into decisions
Require source links for any factual claim before reuse

E_compliance.rationale: Perplexity is vendor-hosted and processes search queries, uploaded documents, and browsing context, while Whisper is open-source and local-command-line oriented with audio-file input. That creates a modest compliance mismatch risk if regulated documents or audio are routed through Perplexity instead of a local-only path. Whisper is not the main compliance concern here, so it is not separately cited beyond its local-only profile fields.
conditions: IF EU PII, PHI, or contractual secrets are uploaded to Perplexity
IF retention or residency requirements apply to the same audio/documents processed by Whisper
mitigations: Route regulated data only to approved local tools
Check vendor retention settings before upload
Use a data-classification gate before Perplexity use
Document which datasets may be sent to each agent
